title: Corn, twenty-seven
logline: September 12 at Gully's: the corn on the counter beside the end stool, from behind the stool — a shoulder, the tray, and Gully's hand setting a coffee down beside it. The first anniversary shared.

panels.composition: From behind the end stool: a man's shoulder in plaid, a paper tray of corn on the counter before him, and a stocky hand setting a coffee beside the tray. The corkboard above. No faces.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, seen from behind a shop's end stool, a man's plaid shoulder with a paper tray of buttered corn on the counter before him and a stocky man's hand setting a coffee beside it, a crowded corkboard above, no faces, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
